subject: Operational telemetry integration & escalation matrix — kickoff
messages:
From: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.inference>
To: Sam Park <sam.park@acmehealth.com>, ops-platform@acmehealth.com
Cc: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.inference>, ben_carter <ben@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 11 Apr 2028 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Operational telemetry integration & escalation matrix — kickoff

Hi Sam / Acme ops team —

Thanks again for agreeing to run the telemetry integration with us next week. I wanted to kick off the thread to capture scope, owners, and a lightweight timeline so we have a single place to track decisions before the implementation sprint. High level goals:

- Enable MDF-level dashboards for inference latency, request fan-out, and token throughput.
- Instrument tracing hooks for end-to-end request IDs and the model-kv cache boundary.
- Define error taxonomy for retryable vs customer-impacting failures.
- Agree alert routing & on-call escalation matrix; provide an initial runbook template.

Suggested owners (please confirm):
- Redwood lead: Laura Bennett (dashboards + runbook)
- Redwood infra: Ben Carter (traces + agent configs)
- Acme lead: Sam Park (ingest, ACLs, SIEM integration)

Proposed kickoff timeline:
- 4/12: scoping session (30 min) — data retention, privacy constraints, and dashboard fields
- 4/17–4/21: instrumentation sprint — tracing + prefix/KV tags deployed to staging
- 4/24: runbook & alert routing review; delivery of escalation matrix draft

Action items for kickoff meeting:
1) Sam: confirm whether Acme will send logs to our collector endpoint or host a Collector (we support both).
2) Acme security: list any fields that must be redacted/hashed before ingest.
3) Laura/Ben: bring initial dashboard wireframe and example trace spans.

Attachments: telemetry-scope.xlsx (initial fields + retention), runbook-template.md

If the owners above look good, I’ll add the calendar invite now for 4/12 09:30 PDT.

Thanks —
Karthik
Sr. Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Sam Park <sam.park@acmehealth.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.inference>
Cc: ops-platform@acmehealth.com, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.inference>, ben_carter <ben@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 11 Apr 2028 11:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Operational telemetry integration & escalation matrix — kickoff

Thanks Karthik — appreciated. Quick answers before the 4/12 session:

- We will host our own collector in the Acme VPC and forward sanitized telemetry to Redwood. Security will not permit direct ingest to a third-party endpoint in Prod. Staging can use your collector for speed.
- We need to redact patient_id and ssn-like PII fields; we will provide a list by end of day Thursday.
- For alerting, our preferred flow is: Team Pager -> Level 1 on-call -> Level 2 (Platform SRE) -> Redwood on-call (for model/runtime issues). Can you provide a template escalation matrix so we can map team names to phone/pager endpoints?

A couple of constraints to flag: Acme requires 90-day raw telemetry retention in staging and 365-day aggregated retention in prod; any shorter-term KV cache artifacts need not be stored long-term.

Looking forward to the kickoff. 4/12 09:30 works for us.

—Sam
Head of Platform & Reliability
Acme Health
From: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.inference>
To: Sam Park <sam.park@acmehealth.com>, ops-platform@acmehealth.com
Cc: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.inference>, ben_carter <ben@redwood.inference>, hannah_schmitt <hannah@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 12 Apr 2028 09:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Operational telemetry integration & escalation matrix — kickoff

On Thu, 11 Apr 2028 at 11:07, Sam Park <sam.park@acmehealth.com> wrote:
> Thanks Karthik — appreciated. Quick answers before the 4/12 session:
>
> - We will host our own collector in the Acme VPC and forward sanitized telemetry to Redwood.
> - We need to redact patient_id and ssn-like PII fields; we will provide a list by end of day Thursday.
> - For alerting, our preferred flow is: Team Pager -> Level 1 on-call -> Level 2 (Platform SRE) -> Redwood on-call (for model/runtime issues).
>
> A couple of constraints to flag: Acme requires 90-day raw telemetry retention in staging and 365-day aggregated retention in prod; any shorter-term KV cache artifacts need not be stored long-term.

Thanks for the clarity, Sam — this is helpful. We’ll adapt the plan:

- Collector model: Redwood will provide a lightweight forwarder you can deploy in the VPC; it forwards only approved fields. Ben will share the forwarder manifest and a staging helm chart during the instrumentation sprint.
- Redaction: please send the initial redaction list; Laura will validate mappings against our dashboard fields so nothing required for SLOs is removed.
- Retention: we’ll make the retention parameters configurable per-environment; Laura will mark required aggregate metrics for 365-day storage.

I’ll send the 4/12 calendar invite in a minute (09:30 PDT) and attach the escalation-matrix-v1.pdf as a starting point. Looking forward to the meeting.

Karthik
From: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.inference>
To: Sam Park <sam.park@acmehealth.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.inference>, ben_carter <ben@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 13 Apr 2028 16:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Operational telemetry integration & escalation matrix — kickoff (notes & next steps)

Follow-up / notes from the kickoff and first validation pass: 

Summary of what we covered:
- Dashboard wireframes: latency P95/P99, token throughput by model, request fanout heatmap. I attached a quick wireframe and the runbook-template we discussed.
- Tracing hooks: agreed span names and the propagation of request_id through the model-serving layer. Ben will publish the span schema to the shared Drive.
- Error taxonomy: introduced three buckets — transient, partial-degraded, hard-failure. Action mapping documented in escalation-matrix-v1.pdf.

Open action items (owners / ETA):
1) Sam / Acme security: redaction list (ETA: 2028-04-14 EOD) — affects staging manifest.
2) Ben: forwarder helm chart + manifest (ETA: 2028-04-17) — staging deploy instructions included.
3) Laura: finalize dashboard wireframe + 365d aggregation map (ETA: 2028-04-20) — see attached runbook-template.md for sections we’ll populate.
4) Karthik: coordinate runbook handoff meeting and contact info mapping with Acme on-call (ETA: 2028-04-24)

Attachments referenced: escalation-matrix-v1.pdf (included), runbook-template.md (included), telemetry-scope.xlsx (previous).

If any of the owners want to push their ETA earlier or need a quick sync, reply-all and we’ll slot 15 minutes. Otherwise we’ll meet 4/24 for the runbook review.

Thanks everyone —
Laura Bennett
Product Ops
Redwood Inference
